identityBasis: Named Inglisild bridge footway35184405327539 and Angel’s Bridge POI17592517490936 in standard PMTiles; original Q12364556 reference. Anchor is refined to the crossing with Lossi for correctly centered portico bays; unequal bank wings retain the mapped footway ends. No exact-QID footprint claimed.

vector.note: The extract keeps zooms 0-maxLevel, so the archive also carries layers the app never reads: landcover (zoom 0-7), earth, boundaries and places.
